payload.question: Is the council earning what it expected from the buildings it rents out?
payload.label: Income from investment property against target, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The council owns commercial buildings and rents them out. It expects to collect at least 95% of the income it budgeted for, and says it will step in below 85.5%. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it collected 98%.
